emma: Heads-up — onboarding mpt-XL-70b-v2 to serving. Need a quick readiness check for quantization + tokenizer quirks before we run a full AWQ calibration. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/mpt-xl-70b/v2/weights.tar.gz. Planning AWQ first, then a short GPTQ/FP8 comparison. Requesting approval for calibration dataset and accuracy tradeoff envelope. ping @raj for config lint and @liam for tokenizer review.

raj: Thanks — quick Qs: where are the calibration samples (path + size)? Are they deduped/anonymized? Also, do we have a baseline fp16 eval to compare against?

emma: Calib samples: s3://redwood-eval/calib/mpt-xl/v2/5k.jsonl (5k examples, anonymized + deduped). Baseline fp16 eval is at s3://redwood-eval/baselines/mpt-xl/v2/fp16_eval.jsonl (perplexity + rouge). Ran a tiny AWQ pilot locally — top-1 ppl delta ~ +1.8% vs fp16 on a 500-sample subset. Proposed quant config below: 

```
quant:
  backend: awq
  bits: 3
  group_size: 128
  calib_samples: s3://redwood-eval/calib/mpt-xl/v2/5k.jsonl
  calibrate_method: per-channel
  dump_stats: true
```

Can we approve using AWQ with these defaults for a staging run?

liam: Noted — tokenizer oddness: the model repo uses a slightly different BPE table (vocab offset) so some prompts split differently (we saw <unk> insertion on long system prompts). Workaround is a small pre-tokenize step: `text = text.replace('\n', ' \n ')` + using the model's tokenizer file from the release tarball. I opened PR for the serving adapter: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/452 — includes patch and test.

noah: FWIW I started a short GPTQ comparison yesterday. GPTQ gave marginally better ppl (0.8% improvement over AWQ on that subset) but inference throughput drops ~12% on A100. So tradeoff: slightly better quality vs higher latency/cost. FP8 expectation: similar to AWQ in quality but gives better memory footprint; need to validate numeric stability.

emma: OK — current ask: permission to run full AWQ calibration on staging and then push a canary if perf/quality are within thresholds. Proposed canary gates:
- weights present in s3
- tokenizer fix merged into serving-adapter
- calibration samples validated (checksum + sample audit)
- perf: median token latency <= 4ms on canary hardware
- quality: perplexity delta <= 3% vs fp16 on the 5k set

Who can sign-off once the staging runs finish?

raj: I can sign off after staging perf + basic smoke tests. @liam please review the tokenizer PR today. @noah can you run a 10k sample GPTQ/FP8 side-by-side and dump results to /tmp/quant-reports/mpt-xl-v2.json (include ppl, latency, memory)?

liam: On it — will review the tokenizer PR and run the serving adapter unit tests. If anything odd, I'll leave comments on the PR.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cluster reserved for 2 hours starting 2026-03-09T14:00Z. Resource: canary-a100-3 (gpu: a100-80gb x3).

noah: Started GPTQ job on `gpu8` (job id 87624). ETA ~2h. I will post a summary to this thread and upload the comparison JSON to s3://redwood-eval/quant-reports/mpt-xl/v2/ when done.

emma: Thanks — if we get sign-offs by EOD we can promote to canary tomorrow and monitor for 48h. :rocket: Let me know if anyone wants to join the staging run review (I can share screen).
